sections.title: Moby-Dick (The One Series)
sections.description: This seminar offers students the opportunity to undertake a semester-long in-depth study of a major literary text from the 19th Century. Discussions will address emergent research methods, advanced writing and critical thinking issues, and debates surrounding canonization. See the English Department's website at www.english.upenn.edu for a description of current offerings.
